snippet.title: Worming from Home Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Climb the corporate ladder as a worm navigating the challenges of remote work. Smash keyboards, survive awkward video calls, and chase your next promotion in this delightfully absurd simulation game.

Learn more about the showcase here: theindiepremier.com
